source_span: Inverse heating oil is still the 10-year. TTF is through €70. "Trading as if they were the same asset. if we want relief on rates we first need relief on energy."
source_chain: Mideast/Russian refinery capacity is damaged and Iran's Sept 2 strikes hit product infrastructure during market hours while oil was already rising, therefore refined product (diesel/gasoil/heating oil/TTF) broke out to new highs above the 2022 print, therefore the 10-year is trading as the energy complex's twin and cannot rally until energy gets relief first (Goldman's desk runs inverse heating oil vs. the 10-year, per Amanda Ross) — invalidated only if the energy driver reverses, per Goldman's own forecast of the 10-year 30-40bp lower 'if the driver goes away', with George Cole's rates-vol tell as the check on whether the move is fundamental or fragile.
pulse_chain: Refinery capacity damage across the Mideast/Russia broke diesel, gasoil, heating oil and European gas to new highs, therefore Goldman's desk states rates cannot rally until energy falls first and runs that as a position (Amanda Ross, inverse heating oil vs. the 10-year), therefore Europe's gas bill is repricing ECB hikes and pushing German/French yields to multi-year highs, with one session's Fed-driven front-end rally (Waller) explained as Fed commentary rather than an energy reversal — invalidated only if the energy driver goes away, per Goldman's own 30-40bp-lower 10-year forecast, with George Cole's rates-vol tell and the ISM prices-paid print as the watch signals.
why: The pulse keeps Goldman's order-of-operations claim, its named attributions (Privorotsky/Duttenhoefer's desk, Amanda Ross's trade, George Cole's vol tell), and the identical invalidation (10-year down 30-40bp only if energy reverses), treating the added JPMorgan Hormuz view and the Waller session as compatible complications rather than reversals of that chain.
